purpose: Current-source research radar for topics likely to improve Crew Blueprint curriculum architecture, safety-awareness coverage, workforce-role mapping, and source freshness. These are research inputs, not learner authorization or automatic curriculum claims.

verified_current_inputs.current_fact: OSHA issued updated National Emphasis Program CPL 03-00-024 for outdoor and indoor heat-related hazards, effective April 10, 2026.
why_it_matters: source freshness for C-OUT-HEAT and related content
verified_current_inputs.recommended_use: Refresh high-level hazard-recognition, employer-program, escalation, and source citations. Preserve state-plan and site-specific variation.
verified_current_inputs.prohibited_use: Do not convert the enforcement program into a universal stagehand procedure, medical protocol, or independent-work authorization.

verified_current_inputs.current_fact: OSHA issued National Emphasis Program CPL-03-00-026 for Warehousing and Distribution Center Operations dated July 31, 2026.
why_it_matters: career-lane transfer between shop and event work
source prioritization for C-SHP-* and C-LOG-PRODUCTION research
verified_current_inputs.recommended_use: Use as a current enforcement-context source and as a trigger for targeted review of the warehouse/rental-shop evidence package against the hazards and work environments OSHA is emphasizing.
verified_current_inputs.prohibited_use: Do not infer that every entertainment warehouse is inspected under identical conditions or turn an enforcement emphasis program into equipment-operation instruction.

verified_current_inputs.current_fact: OSHA extended HCS 2024 compliance dates in January 2026 and issued current inspection procedures effective May 19, 2026. Employer update/training dates shown in 29 CFR 1910.1200 include November 20, 2026 for substances and May 19, 2028 for mixtures, as applicable.
why_it_matters: avoiding stale compliance dates in curriculum
verified_current_inputs.recommended_use: Refresh source metadata and high-level label/SDS/employer-training awareness content where relevant; maintain the distinction between current legal requirements and Crew Blueprint explanatory framing.
verified_current_inputs.prohibited_use: Do not provide chemical-handling or hazardous-substance response procedures beyond general recognition, employer instruction, and escalation boundaries.

verified_current_inputs.current_fact: ETCP maintains distinct Entertainment Electrician and Portable Power Distribution Technician certifications. Its examination content is based on formal job analysis with subject-matter experts and broad practitioner input, and eligibility emphasizes work experience and other qualifying pathways.
why_it_matters: designing a real career/role map instead of one invented ladder
identifying knowledge domains without implying novice work authority
verified_current_inputs.recommended_use: Use ETCP scope/job-analysis material as an external taxonomy and qualification-boundary input for the hierarchical role map and Electrics research architecture.
verified_current_inputs.prohibited_use: Do not copy certification exam content, teach hazardous electrical procedures to beginners, or imply Crew Blueprint completion confers ETCP eligibility or qualified-person status.

verified_current_inputs.current_fact: ETCP maintains Arena and Theatre rigging certifications with work-experience-centered eligibility and a job-analysis-based examination development process.
why_it_matters: distinguishing awareness/support curriculum from specialist practice
verified_current_inputs.recommended_use: Use only for role taxonomy, career-path context, competency-domain discovery, and explicit external qualification gates.
verified_current_inputs.prohibited_use: Do not use certification material to create novice rigging procedures, work-at-height instructions, or independent rigging authorization claims.

verified_current_inputs.current_fact: ESTA's Technical Standards Program is ANSI-accredited and dedicated to entertainment technology, with standards work spanning industry safety and interoperability topics.
why_it_matters: avoiding generic web sources when a relevant entertainment standard exists
verified_current_inputs.recommended_use: Add TSP as a standards-registry/watch source. Store standard identity, scope, revision/freshness, applicability, and citation metadata rather than copying standards wholesale into the repository.
verified_current_inputs.prohibited_use: Do not treat standards metadata as proof that a specific learner-facing claim is supported; claim-level review is still required.
